reason: One major bug remains: on JSON parse failure the program prints plain text to stdout, corrupting the expected single JSON output. With one iteration left, we should fix this critical I/O issue and address small but impactful reproducibility and configuration fixes (age-share renormalization, RNG seeding, deferred plotting). These changes will materially improve robustness without large refactors. Model accuracy remains largely unevaluated; adding minor realism (fatigue damping) is optional if time permits.

specific_areas: Route JSON parse errors to stderr and avoid printing non-JSON to stdout; optionally early-return a clean JSON error object.
Honor share_age_65_plus and renormalize age shares to sum to 1.0.
Make Poisson sampling reproducible by seeding numpy Generator from the provided rng or using a consistent Python-only fallback.
Defer matplotlib import to visualize() with try/except to prevent ImportError in headless environments.
Make neighbor influence correlation optional and/or compute at a configurable reduced frequency (default weekly or disabled).
Remove redundant 'pass' statements where code exists to improve clarity.
Optional: attenuate sharing probabilities by fatigue with a configurable factor.

model_planning.adjustments: Deprioritize new model features; plan a minimal change set focused on output cleanliness, reproducibility, and config correctness. If time remains, include a simple fatigue damping parameter.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement targeted patches: stderr logging and early-return on JSON parse failure; age-share renormalization including 65+; RNG-seeded Poisson; deferred matplotlib import; optional neighbor-correlation frequency flag; remove redundant pass statements.

code_verification.adjustments: Add tests that: (1) feed malformed JSON and verify stdout contains a single valid JSON object and errors go to stderr; (2) confirm reproducibility across runs with fixed seed (including Poisson); (3) validate age shares sum to 1 and distribution matches config; (4) ensure program runs without matplotlib installed; (5) confirm neighbor-correlation metric respects frequency/disable flags.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run smoke tests with default config and with malformed input; run with neighbor correlation disabled and weekly to ensure performance toggle works; test with plotting enabled/disabled; verify CSV export still functions.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Validate that outputs remain a single, clean JSON object; ensure metrics arrays lengths are consistent; if fatigue damping is added, sanity-check that sharing rates decrease with rising fatigue.
